integrity: Characteristic-independent combinatorial lattice proof. The two-part complete-bipartite case was already treated separately and is not claimed as new. No external independence is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Classifies smooth torus-fixed points, not positive-dimensional singular strata; finite computations do not prove the all-parameter formulas; possible unindexed multipartite simplicial-chamber counts remain an originality risk.
title: Smooth toric fixed points of complete-multipartite graphical zonotopes
